headline: RBC Capital Maintains Sector Perform on Eastman Chemical, Raises Price Target to $74
summary: RBC Capital  analyst Arun Viswanathan   maintains Eastman Chemical (NYSE:EMN) with a Sector Perform and raises the price target from $69 to $74.
